objective: Each invocation creates an independent run, fills jobs in separate retained tabs and defaults to manual final Submit on the employer pages.
authorization: User explicitly permits duplicate employer applications across different runs. This does not authorize development-time employer Submit clicks.

execution.identity: One generated UUID is used in the manifest, progress, application export and automatic directory name.
execution.directory: Default logs/direct_submit/TIMESTAMP-UUID. Optional unused --run-dir uses that exact destination; reused destinations get a unique sibling.
execution.ledger: Each direct run owns applications-ledger.json. Fresh runs never consult the shared legacy ledger. Explicit legacy resumes copy only claims belonging to their own attempts.
execution.prior_status: Prior applied/uncertain/discarded execution states in selected input are provenance. Inventory admission and live posting checks remain applicable.
execution.continuation: Failed/uncertain jobs are recorded and subsequent jobs continue. Possible submissions are not automatically re-clicked within a run.
execution.portal_duplicate: Fresh posting-scoped duplicate headings or alerts after final activation are recorded as duplicate/portal_duplicate, and the batch continues.
execution.reports: Each run owns its state, input, events, preparation evidence, retry/review exports and canonical applications.json. Manual handoffs also appear in manual-review.json and manual-review.txt.
execution.history: Application entity identity includes run UUID and posting key. A new retry run leaves its parent run unchanged. Existing custom exports get a unique filename on reuse.
execution.cache: Hash-verified resume artifacts may be reused from the shared output-dir cache; preparation reports and execution state remain per-run.
execution.resume: Explicit resume reconnects live manual tabs and continues unstarted jobs within the cumulative cap. Lost manual tabs remain uncertain because their employer outcome cannot be inferred.
execution.manual_review: No Tk window. Each handoff reserves its posting, saves a tab mapping and immediately continues filling the batch. The monitor reads Chrome targets without activating tabs.
execution.confirmation: Trusted manual clicks are observed, not issued. Confirmed success/duplicates finish; known form rejection stays editable; unclear outcomes remain uncertain and are never auto-reclicked.
execution.cap: Outstanding manual Submit/correction tabs reserve the per-run budget.

shared_preparation: Current profile/config facts and Web source
User first-option choice policy and DEI opt-out policy
Same saved optimizer JSON as LinkedIn
Automatic resume/PDF/hash/attachment checks; no restored manual PDF review gate
AI drafting and accessible field handling
TXT/simple JSON/verified ranked StageResult/legacy queue input
Original role/company IDs and verification versus ranking provenance

validation.syntax_and_diff: py_compile, plan JSON parsing and git diff --check passed
validation.scope: Synthetic local HTTP forms and local uploads only. No employer form submissions or live employer preparation runs.

related_limitations: The earlier Ashby persistence/validation incident remains a separate known issue; independent-run semantics do not establish why that historical save failed.
Unsupported widgets, access challenges and unknown confirmations retain explicit outcomes.
